fields.statement: QA at be2335f89: built ./cmd/rhiza to a scratch path and ran it in a scratch repo under a scratch Rhiza root (env -i). Happy: roadmap --all --json gives title 'Stream exports' for a set title, 'Cache the roadmap' (intent's first clause) and 'No comma at all in this rather' (30-char cut) when none is set; roadmap --json and api call roadmap print the same bytes. A paused daemon serving the web UI rendered /p/repo/roadmap and /p/repo/fragments/roadmap with each row's link text the title and the full intent in <small> beneath; served rhiza.css clamps .rz-row-title small to 2 lines; a change set with a depends-on link keeps 'depends on 1 change set' as its own small.rz-row-note line; HTML in title and intent is escaped; row links return 200. Failure: /p/nope/roadmap 404, roadmap --milestone exits 2 with a usage error. /p/repo/ and /p/repo/runs still render 200. Scoped tests: go test ./internal/web/... ok, ./internal/api -run Roadmap ok, ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/(describe-golden|roadmap) ok.
